_doc: DEFAULT real training config for IL / base supervised training (diffusion_planner/train_predictor.py, the README predictor training) on a v1 dataset. From --base_model (warm-start) or from scratch when omitted. NO n_train_cap/n_val_cap => trains on the ENTIRE pointed dataset (matches the canonical trainer, which has no cap). For a quick 'did I break it' PR check on a small subsample, use il_ci.json instead.
